---
title: "Poster Session"
---

The poster session runs **5:00 – 7:00** in **CGIS Knafel, Fisher Family Commons**, with a happy hour and pizza. Poster Session Awards and concluding remarks from Gal, Sam, and Jack are announced at **7:00**.

Each poster has one discussant.

## Political Violence Against Masses, Elites, and the State

- **[Haley Daarstad](https://haleydaarstad.com/)** — *The Rise of Criminal Violence Against Political Actors and its Influence on Candidate Selection in Mexico*
    - Discussant: Josephine Lechartre
- **[Giordano Nestola](https://www.carloalberto.org/person/giordano-nestola/)** — *Beyond Ideological Sorting: Citizens' Evaluation of Real-World Violent Political Actors*
    - Discussant: Miku Matsunaga
- **Dorit Daria Shmuelli and [Reut Itzkovitch Malka](https://www.openu.ac.il/en/personalsites/DrReutItzkovitchMalka.aspx)** — *Recruitment and Representation in Israeli Local Politics*
    - Discussant: Keren Levy Ganany Snider

## State Repression, Mass Movements, and Mass Violence

- **[Mert Bayraktar](https://ps.ucdavis.edu/people/mert-bayraktar)** — *Striking Back: Commodity Shocks and Anti-Union Violence in Colombia*
    - Discussant: Angela Alonso
- **[Paul Binder](https://www.en.gsi.uni-muenchen.de/people/academic/paul_binder/index.html)** — *Explaining the Geography of Discontent: How Economic Shocks Affect the Spatial Dynamics of Protest*
    - Discussant: Neeraj Prasad
- **[Hongzhe (Simon) Sun](https://www.sg.pku.edu.cn/szdw/zzjs/zzxyjzx/1201900zfglxyx1361747.htm)** — *Is the Civil War Still Going On?*
    - Discussant: George Melios

## Violence in International Relations

- **[Michael Cerny](https://michaelbcerny.net)** — *Disciplining the Democratic Peace: A Partial Identification Approach*
    - Discussant: Jack Rametta
- **[Matthew Koo](https://politicalscience.yale.edu/people/matthew-koo)** — *Who Stays Loyal? Security Personnel Support in Authoritarian and Democratic Elections*
    - Discussant: Hojung Joo

## Democratic Backsliding and Accountability

- **[Murat Akdogan](https://www.muratakdogan.com/)** — *When Democracy Still Constrains: The Microfoundations of Democratic Accountability Under Party-Democracy Conflict*
    - Discussant: Amnon Cavari
